== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text (the PC website card list). No published image shows this text. Other versions: [[Luke, Trust Me]] (original), [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L5704</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_116</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB7-03-Luke_Trust_Me-PC-E1-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
